scope: R5 owner-requested slight increase in spontaneous facial expression
owner_feedback: A little more smirks and smiles and slight lookaways and micro expressions; slightly more expressive like an unplanned talk.
clarification: Unplanned talk. Not fall or call.

segments.text:
It’s hard to leave an app alone when it looks like something you could sell.

I’ve gotta get better at that. With AI, I can get something looking pretty good before I’ve worked out why anyone would actually use it.

So I’m building this GTM Engine to help me work through that. It looks at the code, then researches who might use it and what they’re doing already.

Because if they’ve already got a way that works, why would they bother with mine?

But I still wanna let someone try it on something they actually need to do. Do they choose mine, or go back to what they were using before?

Maybe I’ve gotta build a bit more to find that out. That’s fine.

But I’ve got other projects I wanna work on too, so I want more to go on than how good this one looks.

And if I just enjoy using it myself, I can leave it at that. It’s okay to have a hobby.

So you guys tell me, what made you decide to turn something you’d built into a business?

Vertical smartphone selfie talking-head video of the same owner-authorized adult man at home. The IMAGE is the exact identity and appearance reference: transparent glasses, same hair, stubble, natural skin, muted olive casual overshirt open over an off-white T-shirt. Keep the home room with window and sheer curtain on image-left, shelves on image-right, soft daylight, close front-camera framing, phone held just above eye level at arm's length outside frame. Keep framing, supporting arm, shoulders and room steady with only the existing slight handheld character.

Performance intention: an unplanned talk, casually thinking aloud to a familiar viewer. Only slightly more expressive than a restrained natural read. The image anchors his likeness, not a frozen expression. Allow brief asymmetric half-smiles and self-aware smirks, tiny cheek and eye-corner responses, irregular natural blinking, a small brow release, and a short thought-related glance where specified. Expressions develop out of the words and dissolve naturally into attentive rest. Relaxed face between reactions is part of the performance. Keep the eyes engaged and warm, not wide. Favor small facial changes over extra head motion.

The supplied AUDIO governs the exact words, cadence, pitch, pace and speech timing. Preserve every word, including contractions, without adding, repeating or omitting speech. Begin at the audio's actual onset. Keep articulation connected and finish the last word fully. No added laugh, filler, vocal sound, music, ambience or sound effect. This is a recorded selfie talk, not a video-call interface.

Avoid a fixed grin, sales smile, repeated eyebrow pumping, predictable nods, large toothy smiles, restless eye-darting or repeated scheduled glances. Do not turn away for a whole sentence. Keep his identity, glasses, wardrobe, light, camera distance and screen direction consistent. No subtitles, overlays, B-roll, zooms, cuts or scene changes inside this clip.

A quick slight side glance during the transition into "With AI" can read as searching for the next thought; return naturally to the lens while continuing. Explain the GTM Engine plainly with live but small eye and brow responses. No promotional smile. End near the lens, ready to continue rather than saying goodbye.
